column1: # LUAU-1 (review 2026-11-21): how the Luau generators spell a string literal.
# input: the Go string, written as a Go double-quoted literal (strconv.Unquote).
# want: the Luau literal luau.StringLit must emit, byte for byte. Go's %q is
#       kept wherever it is also Luau; \u{X} replaces the \uXXXX and
# controls: spellings Go's %q and Luau share
# the defect: runes Go's %q writes as \uXXXX or \UXXXXXXXX
